sentences.text: Your Devocean is a cohort company whose country is recorded as SE, and the sources we read hold no register entry for it.
The record has two exhibitor or demo entries, dated 2025-04-03 and 2026-08-19, and a programme-entry record on the apelago.fi site dated 2026-02-09.
No funding, patent or contract record is on file, so every readiness level is unknown.
For the fund this stays on the watchlist.
